filters.title: Inventory filters
filters.search: Search product name, product SKU or variant SKU
filters.productHelp: Search applies only to loaded products. Clear the search and scroll the dropdown to browse more.
filters.productsError: Could not load products. Retry to restore product labels and options.
filters.scrollProducts: Scroll down for more products. If search hides the options, clear it to continue browsing.
filters.emptyDescription: Change or reset filters to view other stock in this warehouse.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Choose a warehouse to view its stock and carry out stocktaking.
inventory.directoryPageDescription: View recorded stock and manage warehouse stocktaking.
inventory.directoryEmpty: No warehouses are available to select.
inventory.workspaceDescription: Recorded variant stock in this warehouse.
inventory.threshold: Reported low-stock threshold: {{threshold}}. Status is supplied by the inventory system.
inventory.refreshDescription: Reload recorded inventory values for this page without changing stock quantities.

stocktake.title: Quick Stocktake
stocktake.description: Count this variant in this warehouse, then review the replacement quantity.
stocktake.countHelp: Enter the final counted quantity, including zero. This replaces recorded stock; it does not add or subtract a difference.
stocktake.replaceSummary: Replace the recorded quantity of {{recorded}} with the physical count of {{counted}} for the variant and warehouse above.
stocktake.recheckHelp: The balance is checked again before saving. Other stock activity can still occur between this check and the update.

notices.changed: Recorded stock changed while you were counting. The current balance is shown above. Your count is preserved; review the new variance before continuing.
notices.missing: This stock record is no longer available. No update was applied. Close this drawer and refresh inventory.
notices.readError: Current stock could not be verified. Your count is preserved. Check your connection and review again to retry.
notices.forbidden: You do not have permission for this stock operation. Your count has been preserved.
notices.saveError: The stock update could not be confirmed. Your count is preserved. Review again to verify the latest balance before retrying.
notices.unchanged: Your physical count matches the recorded quantity. No update is needed.

empty.title: No stock records in this warehouse
empty.description: This warehouse has no recorded stock entries.

emptyPage.title: No stock records on this page
emptyPage.description: Refresh data or choose another page.
